scope: Local review only; no router access, package installation, compiler rebuild or QEMU execution.

package_status.gcc16_base_note: gcc-16-base is runtime package metadata and common files; its presence is not an installed GCC16 compiler.
package_status.isolated_glibc: /opt/leon-glibc244 appears only in the generated QEMU fixture. The rootfs tar retains official libc6 2.43-2ubuntu2.4 and its truthful dpkg ownership.

time64_evidence.date2100: date --date=2100-01-01 +%s proves userspace parsing/representation only, not a kernel timestamp API.
time64_evidence.current_clock: clock_gettime may use vDSO; current-date success is not proof of a post2038 syscall.
time64_evidence.future_timer: The armel/hf probes pass2147483664 (>INT32_MAX) to __timerfd_settime64@GLIBC_2.34. glibc2.44 timerfd_settime.c uses INLINE_SYSCALL_CALL(timerfd_settime64) for this range; there is no vDSO implementation. ENOSYS becomes EOVERFLOW, never synthetic success. An accepted future timer therefore tests the actual ARM32 kernel syscall411.
time64_evidence.limit: Bounded future timer-setting test only; do not extrapolate to every time64/IPC/timestamp interface. Current clock may use vDSO, while the future timer cannot.

changes: Clarify archive-signature trust is not a signature on the rootfs tar.
Record script/hook SHA256 and note live archive contents are not a byte-reproducible pinned snapshot.
rootfs_builder_fix.validation: Python AST parse passed. Existing successful candidate build log contains all3suite InRelease hits and armhf indices, with no W:/E:/Err: fetch failures. This review did not rebuild or replace the candidate tar.

fixture_review.finding: 116 hardlinks retained using shared newc inode groups, eliminating duplicated multicall coreutils payloads.
fixture_review.future_hardening: Reject nonregular/incompatible hardlink targets for generic inputs; normalize probe.deb timestamps before claiming bit-identical repeated fixture generation.

fixture_review.finding: BusyBox ash selected its dpkg applet and rejected --audit.
fixture_review.status: Parent fixed init to Ubuntu /bin/sh; fixture issue, not kernel/dpkg ABI failure.

fixture_review.finding: apt --no-download did not handle the local .deb archive path in this fixture.
fixture_review.status: Parent removed the flag; QEMU has noNIC, so the fixture remains offline.

fixture_review.finding: systemd timer completion does not prove service execution.
fixture_review.acceptance: Require exact serial line LAB_SYSTEMD_SERVICE_STARTED. About to execute debug text contains the same phrase without having spawned anything. Current recorded systemd run fails executor spawn ENOSYS.

fixture_review.finding: glibc244 explicit-loader checks are isolated tests, not package upgrades.
fixture_review.interpretation: apt --version with explicit glibc2.44 is a startup check only. apt install/remove uses official Ubuntu libc; do not call it apt package integration with glibc2.44.

policy_consistency: Profile labels offline preparation and custom package builds pending, defaults rebuilt armel/hf to time64/LFS64, and limits legacy exceptions to proven individual boundaries. Earlier broad -U settings are historical evidence, not new defaults.
